The '''Senate Security Officers''', known simply known as '''SSOs''' and referred to at times as '''Senate Security''', were [[Republic soldier|soldiers]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Republic Military/Legends|military]] that shared jurisdiction of protecting the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] with the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] and subsequent [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==History==
During the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Senate Security Officers, or SSOs, were [[Republic soldier]]s who were assigned the duty of protecting the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="TORFA" /> along with [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]] of the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]]<ref name="SWTORcodex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Senate Tower}}</ref> who held the title of [[Senate Guard (Coruscant Security Force)|''Senate Guards'']].<ref name="Coruscant">{{TORcite|Coruscant}}</ref>

The SSOs were in service as early as the [[Great Galactic War]] and subsequent [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Though they were assigned to the Senate Building and the [[Senate District/Legends|Senate District]], SSOs could be reassigned and deployed like other [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] units to military campaigns. In one instance, several SSOs were [[Independent Operation Sebaddon|sent]] with a Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] to claim the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Sebaddon]]. After the conclusion of the mission, [[Supreme Commander (Republic)|Supreme Commander]] [[Stantorrs]] reassigned some of the SSOs as part of a special unit under the command of [[Republic Special Forces Division|Republic Special Forces]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Larin Moxla]].<ref name="TORFA" />

They were eventually replaced by the more formalized, and separate, [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]] organization.<ref name="SWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Senate Security Officers first appeared in ''[[The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance]]''.
